headline: SalfaCorp Subsidiary Secures Contract for Escondida Copper Mine Haul Truck Workshop
summary: Salfa Montajes, a subsidiary of SalfaCorp, signed a contract with BHP's Escondida copper mine to execute structural and electrometallurgical works for a new heavy-duty truck maintenance workshop.
why: Mining infrastructure construction contracts secure multi-year engineering and construction revenues for industrial service providers.

impacts.name: SalfaCorp SA
impacts.why: Winning major mining infrastructure contracts directly boosts order backlogs and future construction revenues.
